papers.title: Genome architecture and duplication-associated functional diversification in the carnivorous plant Sarracenia purpurea
papers.translated_title: 食虫植物紫瓶子草的基因组结构及复制相关的功能多样化
papers.author: Albert, V. A.
papers.summary: The repeated evolution of complex traits raises the question of how genomes generate ecological novelty while preserving developmental organization. We present a chromosome-scale genome assembly and annotation for the carnivorous purple pitcher plant, Sarracenia purpurea, and investigate how two contrasting modes of gene duplication have shaped its genome and functional repertoire: ancient polyploidy, which leaves duplicated genes in conserved chromosomal regions (syntenic duplicates), and local tandem duplication, which generates neighboring gene copies. We compare these duplication classes across nine angiosperms. The genome shows a mosaic of conserved and fractionated duplicated regions reflecting differential retention and loss of genes following ancient polyploidy and later restructuring. Comparison with noncarnivorous Actinidia (kiwifruit) identifies 18 syntenic and nine tandem Gene Ontology (GO) Biological Process term-duplication-class combinations enriched in Sarracenia but not significantly enriched in Actinidia. Syntenic enrichments include meristem maintenance, organ-boundary specification, cuticle development, and hormonal regulation; tandem enrichments include defense responses, oxidative stress, jasmonic-acid biosynthesis, leaf senescence, and oligopeptide transport. Across the carnivorous genera Sarracenia, Nepenthes, Utricularia, and Pinguicula, we identify 19 syntenic and two tandem-associated biological processes showing significant enrichment in all four lineages, revealing striking functional commonalities across multiple evolutionary origins of carnivory despite their divergent trap morphologies and ecological strategies. Among Sarracenia genes differentially expressed in at least one comparison of flower, pitcher-leaf, and root tissues, tandem-class genes exhibit larger maximum absolute expression differences and greater GO richness and effective breadth at matched numbers of annotated homologs. These results highlight the complementary evolutionary contributions of ancient genome duplication and local gene-family expansion to the developmental and ecological diversification of carnivorous plants.
papers.translated_summary: 复杂性状的反复演化提出了一个问题：基因组如何在保持发育组织性的同时产生生态新颖性。我们提出了食肉性紫瓶子草Sarracenia purpurea的染色体尺度基因组组装与注释，并研究了两种对比鲜明的基因复制模式如何塑造了其基因组和功能库：古老的多倍化，其将重复基因保留在保守的染色体区域（共线性重复）；以及局部串联重复，其产生邻近的基因拷贝。我们在九种被子植物中比较了这些复制类别。该基因组显示出保守和片段化重复区域的镶嵌格局，反映了古老多倍化及随后重构后基因的差异保留与丢失。与非食肉性猕猴桃属Actinidia（猕猴桃）的比较鉴定出18个共线性和9个串联的基因本体（GO）生物过程术语-复制类别组合在Sarracenia中富集但在Actinidia中未显著富集。共线性富集包括分生组织维持、器官边界特化、角质层发育和激素调控；串联富集包括防御反应、氧化应激、茉莉酸生物合成、叶片衰老和寡肽转运。在食肉属Sarracenia、Nepenthes、Utricularia和Pinguicula中，我们鉴定出19个共线性和两个串联相关的生物过程在所有四个谱系中均显示显著富集，揭示了尽管捕虫器形态和生态策略各异，但食肉性多次独立起源之间惊人的功能共性。在花、瓶状叶和根组织至少一次比较中差异表达的Sarracenia基因中，串联类基因在匹配的注释同源基因数量下表现出更大的最大绝对表达差异以及更高的GO丰富度和有效广度。这些结果突出了古老基因组复制和局部基因家族扩张对食肉植物发育和生态多样化的互补性演化贡献。

papers.title: FoXSight: Facilitating Computational Hit Identification in Crystallographic Fragment Screening Experiments
papers.translated_title: FoXSight：促进晶体学片段筛选实验中的计算命中识别
papers.author: Schulze, T.
papers.summary: X-ray crystallographic fragment screening reveals how small molecules bind to proteins, providing important starting points for drug design. Identifying these weak binding events remains difficult when electron density signals are noisy, partially occupied or obscured by solvent, and campaigns may comprise thousands of datasets. Here, we present FoXSight, a computational method for hit identification in crystallographic compound screening. FoXSight applies Difference-of-Gaussian (DoG) filtering to multi-reference subtraction maps to detect recurring, target-specific density features associated with bound ligands. Its output maps remain visually interpretable and support subsequent ligand modeling. We evaluated FoXSight on in-house and public datasets spanning seven protein targets, comparing its maps with PanDDA where suitable comparison data were available. FoXSight was successfully used as the primary hit identification tool in a challenging crystallographic fragment screening campaign for human Cathepsin L, where the output of established methods was impractical to inspect systematically.
papers.translated_summary: X射线晶体学片段筛选揭示了小分子如何与蛋白质结合，为药物设计提供了重要的起点。当电子密度信号存在噪声、部分占据或被溶剂遮蔽时，以及筛选活动可能包含数千个数据集时，识别这些弱结合事件仍然困难。在此，我们提出FoXSight，一种用于晶体学化合物筛选中命中识别的计算方法。FoXSight将高斯差分（DoG）滤波应用于多参考减法图，以检测与结合配体相关的重复出现、靶标特异性的密度特征。其输出图保持视觉可解释性，并支持后续的配体建模。我们在涵盖七个蛋白质靶标的内部和公共数据集上评估了FoXSight，并在有合适比较数据的情况下将其图与PanDDA进行比较。FoXSight成功用作人类组织蛋白酶L一项具有挑战性的晶体学片段筛选活动的主要命中识别工具，在该活动中，现有方法的输出无法进行系统性的实际检查。

papers.title: Structural basis for alpha-actinin inhibition of cofilin binding to actin filaments
papers.translated_title: α-辅肌动蛋白抑制丝切蛋白与肌动蛋白丝结合的結構基础
papers.author: Ngo, K. X.
papers.summary: Actin is a conserved cytoskeletal protein essential for morphogenesis, motility, and division. Its versatility arises from filament assembly and regulation by actin binding proteins. Among these, alpha-actinin organizes filaments into bipolar or unipolar networks, whereas cofilin binds preferentially to ADP-actin regions and forms clusters to shorten the half helical pitch (HHP). Here, we investigated the molecular mechanism of how alpha-actinin alters filament and protomer conformations and influences cofilin binding. Using high-speed atomic force microscopy, all-atom molecular dynamics simulations, and principal component analysis, we show that alpha-actinin crosslinking stabilizes actin filaments in the canonical helical state, thereby preventing the cofilin-induced helical shortening required for cooperative filament decoration. Stabilization occurs without significant changes in protomer twist and rise and subdomain geometry and maintains a flattened protomer conformation that restricts twisting needed for cofilin binding. Furthermore, myosin II (S1) and cofilin preferentially bind to normal and shortened half-helical structures, respectively. In contrast, the isolated alpha-actinin-1 actin binding domain mutant (ABD-E235K) and wild-type (ABD-WT) induce local transitions from the canonical double-helical filament to the single-helical protofilament, parallel-helical protofilament state (PPS), and nano-ring structures, while only weakly affecting cofilin binding and cluster formation on PPS. Notably, cofilin can bind and form clusters along single protofilaments without inducing helical-pitch shortening. Together, these findings reveal a mechanistically distinct function of full-length alpha-actinin and its isolated ABD and support a stepwise mechanism in which cofilin cooperative binding to canonical double-helical actin filaments requires initial binding to actin regions with shortened HHP, followed by protomer twisting and further helical shortening.
papers.translated_summary: 肌动蛋白是一种保守的细胞骨架蛋白，对形态发生、运动和分裂至关重要。其多功能性源于丝状组装以及肌动蛋白结合蛋白的调控。其中，α-辅肌动蛋白将丝状体组织成双极性或单极性网络，而丝切蛋白优先结合ADP-肌动蛋白区域并形成簇以缩短半螺旋螺距（HHP）。在此，我们研究了α-辅肌动蛋白如何改变丝状体和原体构象并影响丝切蛋白结合的分子机制。利用高速原子力显微镜、全原子分子动力学模拟和主成分分析，我们表明α-辅肌动蛋白交联将肌动蛋白丝稳定在经典螺旋状态，从而阻止丝切蛋白诱导的螺旋缩短，而后者是协同丝状体装饰所必需的。稳定化发生时不伴随原体扭转和升距及亚结构域几何形状的显著变化，并维持一种扁平的原体构象，该构象限制了丝切蛋白结合所需的扭转。此外，肌球蛋白II（S1）和丝切蛋白分别优先结合正常和缩短的半螺旋结构。相比之下，分离的α-辅肌动蛋白-1肌动蛋白结合结构域突变体（ABD-E235K）和野生型（ABD-WT）诱导从经典双螺旋丝状体向单螺旋原丝、平行螺旋原丝状态（PPS）和纳米环结构的局部转变，同时对丝切蛋白结合及PPS上的簇形成影响微弱。值得注意的是，丝切蛋白可以沿单一原丝结合并形成簇，而不诱导螺旋螺距缩短。总之，这些发现揭示了全长α-辅肌动蛋白及其分离ABD的一种机制上独特的功能，并支持一种逐步机制，即丝切蛋白与经典双螺旋肌动蛋白丝的协同结合需要首先结合到具有缩短HHP的肌动蛋白区域，随后发生原体扭转和进一步的螺旋缩短。

papers.title: Spatial geometry of the Hypoxic niche predicts Radiotherapy failure in Colorectal Cancer: A Spatially Explicit Agent-Based Model
papers.translated_title: 缺氧微空间几何预测结直肠癌放疗失败：一个空间显式的基于主体的模型
papers.author: Panchagnula, S. D. K.
papers.summary: Radiotherapy failure in locally advanced colorectal cancer is mechanistically linked to tumour microenvironmental heterogeneity, yet the spatial determinants of immune clearance following fractionated irradiation remain poorly understood. Here we present a spatially explicit hybrid agent-based model of colorectal cancer response to short-course radiotherapy in which cellular fate - proliferation, dormancy, or necrosis - is governed by local oxygen tension and ATP availability computed via Michaelis - Menten kinetics. Immune killing probability and proliferation rate are implemented as continuous functions of local oxygen, replacing hard thresholds with mechanistically grounded gradients. Simulations of the standard 5 x 5 Gy short-course radiotherapy protocol revealed a bimodal tumour control distribution consistent with clinical observations of cure-or-escape outcomes. The central finding is that spatial position within the oxygen landscape, rather than surviving cell count alone, predicts immune clearance success: runs in which the tumour was eliminated had surviving cells in well-oxygenated regions near vasculature(meanO2 = 0.967), while escaped tumours retained cells concentrated in the hypoxic core (mean O2 = 0.196; Mann - Whitney p= 2.1 x 10-9). Fractionation schedule analysis across equal total-dose protocols demonstrated that inter-fraction interval critically modulates repopulation dynamics and tumour control probability, with compact schedules outperforming widely-spaced fractionation despite identical cumulative dose. Transcriptomic validation using the Buffa hypoxia signature across 284 Stage II/III CRC patients from TCGA confirmed that significant tumour hypoxia is a clinically prevalent feature of the target disease population. These results suggest that the geometry of the hypoxic niche is a spatial determinant of radiotherapy outcome in colorectal cancer, with implications for treatment scheduling and patient stratification by hypoxia burden.
papers.translated_summary: 局部晚期结直肠癌的放疗失败在机制上与肿瘤微环境异质性相关，但分次照射后免疫清除的空间决定因素仍知之甚少。在此，我们提出一个空间显式的混合智能体模型，用于模拟结直肠癌对短程放疗的反应，其中细胞命运——增殖、休眠或坏死——由局部氧张力和通过Michaelis-Menten动力学计算的ATP可用性决定。免疫杀伤概率和增殖速率被实现为局部氧的连续函数，以机制上合理的梯度取代硬阈值。对标准5×5 Gy短程放疗方案的模拟揭示了与临床观察到的治愈或逃逸结局一致的双峰肿瘤控制分布。核心发现是，氧景观中的空间位置而非仅存活细胞计数，可预测免疫清除的成功：肿瘤被消除的运行中，存活细胞位于血管附近氧合良好的区域（平均O2=0.967），而逃逸的肿瘤则保留集中于缺氧核心的细胞（平均O2=0.196；Mann-Whitney p=2.1×10^-9）。跨等总剂量方案的分次照射时间表分析表明，分次间间隔关键性地调节再增殖动力学和肿瘤控制概率，尽管累积剂量相同，紧凑时间表优于宽间隔分次照射。使用Buffa缺氧特征对来自TCGA的284例II/III期CRC患者进行的转录组验证证实，显著肿瘤缺氧是该目标疾病人群的临床普遍特征。这些结果提示，缺氧龛的几何结构是结直肠癌放疗结局的空间决定因素，对治疗排程和按缺氧负荷进行患者分层具有意义。

papers.title: Structure determination and dual targeting of a plant TACO1 identifies its ancient role as an organelle translation regulator
papers.translated_title: 植物TACO1的结构解析及其双重靶向揭示了其作为细胞器翻译调控因子的古老作用
papers.author: Raval, P. K.
papers.summary: Ribosome stalling caused by polyproline (PPs) motifs is common. Their translation is enhanced by accessory proteins such as YebC in bacteria, whose homolog, TRANSLATIONAL ACTIVATOR OF CYTOCHROME C OXIDASE 1 (TACO1), aids the translation of mitochondria-encoded proteins. The prevalence of PP motifs across plastid-encoded genes and their impact on the translation of photosynthesis-relevant proteins remains unexplored. Equally, a translation-enhancer of PP motifs equivalent to TACO1 for plastid ribosomes has not been reported. Here, we show that plastid genomes encode 24 proteins with a minimum of one PP motif on average, half of which are conserved in their cyanobacterial homologs. We also find that the vast majority of eukaryotes, including plants, encode only a single TACO1 that we demonstrate to be dually targeted to mitochondria and plastids of Marchantia polymorpha. We resolved the MpTACO1 structure at 2.34 [A] by X-ray crystallography and its flexibility by small-angle X-ray scattering. Through modelling, we demonstrate that MpTACO1 can fit into the peptidyl transfer centre of plant chlororibosomes in a similar manner as human TACO1 in the mitoribosome. The identification and structure determination of the first plastid-targeted YebC/TACO1 allows us to sketch a unified model for the function and evolution of this ancient family of ribosomal accessory proteins, underscoring their indispensable role in the translation of bioenergetic membrane proteins reaching back almost 4 billion years.
papers.translated_summary: 多聚脯氨酸（PPs）基序引起的核糖体停滞是常见的现象。其翻译由细菌中的YebC等辅助蛋白增强，其同源蛋白——细胞色素c氧化酶1的翻译激活因子（TACO1）——协助线粒体编码蛋白的翻译。PP基序在质体编码基因中的普遍性及其对光合作用相关蛋白翻译的影响尚未被探索。同样，尚未有报道称存在与TACO1相当的、作用于质体核糖体的PP基序翻译增强因子。在此，我们展示质体基因组平均编码24种至少含有一个PP基序的蛋白质，其中一半在其蓝藻同源蛋白中是保守的。我们还发现，绝大多数真核生物（包括植物）仅编码单一TACO1，我们证明该蛋白在地钱（Marchantia polymorpha）中双重靶向线粒体和质体。我们通过X射线晶体学以2.34 Å的分辨率解析了MpTACO1的结构，并通过小角X射线散射研究了其柔性。通过建模，我们证明MpTACO1能够以类似于人TACO1在线粒体核糖体中的方式嵌入植物叶绿体核糖体的肽基转移中心。首个质体靶向YebC/TACO1的鉴定和结构解析使我们能够勾勒出这一古老核糖体辅助蛋白家族的功能和进化的统一模型，突显了它们在近40亿年来生物能量膜蛋白翻译中不可或缺的作用。

papers.title: Ultrasonic emissions of sunflower and buckwheat carry species identity in their spectrum and drought in their rate
papers.translated_title: 向日葵和荞麦的超声波发射在频谱中携带物种身份，在速率中携带干旱信息
papers.author: Saha, B.
papers.summary: Plants under water deficit produce ultrasonic acoustic emissions that can be recorded in air. Species have been compared mainly by peak frequency. We report, to our knowledge, the first airborne recordings of sunflower (Helianthus annuus) and buckwheat (Fagopyrum esculentum), with gas exchange and chlorophyll fluorescence on the same plants. Across 119 recordings of 30 min each, made on two drought and two watered end plants per species, every drought plant emitted more events over the series than the watered plants. Rates rose 107 fold in sunflower and 5.3 fold in buckwheat, coincided with low stomatal conductance, and later fell in single plants. In sunflower, emission was already raised when maximum Photosystem II quantum yield was similar between treatments. At equal loudness, sunflower events carried a median of 24% of their energy at 40-80 kHz, against 2% in buckwheat, in drought and watered plants alike, although both species peaked near 30 kHz. In a proof of concept on four plants per species, this share identified a held-out plant's species in 96% of draws of five events. Airborne ultrasound thus carries species identity in its spectrum and drought in its event rate, two signals a non-contact sensor could combine.
papers.translated_summary: 水分亏缺下的植物会产生可在空气中记录的超声声发射。物种之间的比较主要依据峰值频率。据我们所知，我们首次报道了向日葵（Helianthus annuus）和荞麦（Fagopyrum esculentum）的空气中录音，并对同一植株进行了气体交换和叶绿素荧光测定。每个物种各有两株干旱处理和两株浇水处理的末端植株，共进行119次、每次30分钟的录音，在整个系列中，每株干旱植株发出的声事件均多于浇水植株。向日葵的声发射速率上升了107倍，荞麦上升了5.3倍，与低气孔导度相吻合，随后在单株中下降。在向日葵中，当两种处理间的最大光系统II量子产率相似时，声发射已经升高。在相同响度下，向日葵声事件在40-80 kHz频段携带的能量中位数为24%，而荞麦为2%，干旱植株和浇水植株均如此，尽管两个物种的峰值频率都在30 kHz附近。在每个物种四株植株的概念验证中，这一份额在五次声事件抽取中有96%能识别出留出植株的物种。因此，空气超声在其频谱中携带物种身份信息，在其事件率中携带干旱信息，这是非接触式传感器可以结合的两个信号。

papers.title: Differential DNA methylation and transcriptome revealed enhanced photosynthetic recovery and ROS modulation to promote cold tolerance in Oryza sativa L. ssp. indica.
papers.translated_title: 差异DNA甲基化与转录组揭示增强的光合恢复和ROS调节促进籼稻耐冷性。
papers.author: Roy, V.
papers.summary: Indica rice, being a tropical crop, is highly sensitive to cold temperatures. Cold stress affects vegetative growth, photosynthetic efficiency and reproductive features. Screening diverse landraces to identify novel alleles associated with cold tolerance can be an approach to develop cold resilient indica rice. We have characterized a boro germplasm, CB1, with an efficient germination rate and growth vigor when treated with chilling temperatures. CB1 seedlings show a higher survival rate compared to IR36 when subjected to prolonged chilling stress. Biochemical analysis indicated efficient ROS modulation, higher chlorophyll content, enhanced photosystem II efficiency and unique stomatal traits, leading to higher relative water content in CB1 plants during stress and recovery. Germplasm-specific DNA methylome and transcriptome uniquely regulate the expression of chlorophyll biosynthesis, photosystem, & light harvesting complex and ROS scavenger genes in CB1 seedlings during stress recovery. Interestingly, high D1 protein turnover in CB1 promotes damage repair of PSII for efficient photosynthesis. Furthermore, key transcription factors for stomatal development and expression of photosynthetic genes were upregulated in CB1 during stress recovery. Notably, higher expression of GLK1 and enrichment of GLK1 targets were observed in CB1 plants during chilling stress and recovery. Taken together, our results indicate that GLK1 and WRKY40 negatively regulates the inhibitory role of ABI5 for efficient photosynthetic recovery to enhance cold tolerance in CB1 rice.
papers.translated_summary: 籼稻作为热带作物，对低温高度敏感。低温胁迫影响营养生长、光合效率和生殖特性。筛选丰富的农家品种以鉴定与耐冷性相关的新等位基因，可作为培育耐冷籼稻的一种途径。我们鉴定了一个boro种质CB1，其在低温处理下具有高效的萌发率和生长活力。与IR36相比，CB1幼苗在长时间低温胁迫下表现出更高的存活率。生化分析表明，CB1植株在胁迫和恢复期间具有高效的ROS调控、较高的叶绿素含量、增强的光系统II效率以及独特的气孔性状，从而导致较高的相对含水量。种质特异性的DNA甲基化组和转录组独特地调控了CB1幼苗在胁迫恢复期间叶绿素生物合成、光系统、捕光复合体和ROS清除基因的表达。有趣的是，CB1中较高的D1蛋白周转促进了PSII的损伤修复以实现高效光合作用。此外，气孔发育的关键转录因子和光合基因的表达在CB1胁迫恢复期间上调。值得注意的是，在低温胁迫和恢复期间，CB1植株中GLK1的表达较高且GLK1靶标富集。综上所述，我们的结果表明，GLK1和WRKY40负调控ABI5的抑制作用，以实现有效的光合恢复，从而增强CB1水稻的耐冷性。

papers.title: Two copy-number forms of the Kala4/OsB2 upstream duplication in purple rice revealed by a telomere-to-telomere genome of landrace ZN65
papers.translated_title: 紫米中Kala4/OsB2上游重复的两种拷贝数形式，由地方品种ZN65的端粒到端粒基因组揭示
papers.author: Zhao, F.
papers.summary: Background: Black and purple pericarp in rice requires activation of the regulator Kala4/OsB2. The canonical black-rice allele is a promoter rearrangement that was described from DNA gel blots and amplified fragments, and its sequence is unavailable. Whether pigmented landraces carry one upstream structure or several is therefore unknown. We examined this region in the purple-pericarp landrace Mojiang ZN65 and its distribution in sequenced rice germplasm. Results: We assembled a gap-free telomere-to-telomere genome of ZN65 (395.1 Mb; all 24 telomeres). Upstream of Kala4/OsB2, a 5.87-kb segment (block A) and a 6.0-kb segment that contains the first two annotated exons of OsB2 were each present in three non-tandem copies. The arrangement was reproduced by an independent HiFi-only assembly and was spanned by three Nanopore reads. Among 2,913 accessions of the 3,000 Rice Genomes panel, read depth detected block A gain in 29 (1.0%), 17 at three or more copies and 12 at two. All 29 carried read pairs joining block A to the OsB2 5' segment, and none of 58 matched controls did. A junction specific to the third copy was found in 16 of these 17 and in 2 of these 12. Among 2,055 accessions with recorded seed-coat colour, 18 of 19 purple accessions carried the gain, and purple was recorded for 9 of 13 and 9 of 11 carriers of the two classes. Among 210 NCBI assemblies and 264 Genome Warehouse materials, five carried the junctions with two copies of block A, and one, the Chinese accession Momi, carried three copies, which its Nanopore reads confirmed. An elevated OsKala3 promoter-repeat depth ratio was found in 21 of 29 carriers, and four purple carriers lacked it. Conclusions: ZN65 provides a gap-free, read-supported sequence of a Kala4/OsB2 upstream duplication that occurs in at least two copy-number forms in purple rice. Its gene-proximal part has the same kinds of elements in the same order as the published description of the canonical black-rice allele, although the segment lengths differ. Both forms were found in purple accessions, and the additional copy showed no relation to recorded colour. Its effect on OsB2 expression remains untested.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：水稻黑色和紫色果皮需要调控因子Kala4/OsB2的激活。典型的黑米等位基因是一个启动子重排，此前通过DNA印迹和扩增片段进行了描述，其序列尚不可得。因此，色素地方品种携带一种还是多种上游结构尚不清楚。我们检测了紫果皮地方品种墨江紫糯65（Mojiang ZN65）中该区域及其在已测序水稻种质中的分布。结果：我们组装了ZN65的无缺口端粒到端粒基因组（395.1 Mb；全部24个端粒）。在Kala4/OsB2上游，一个5.87 kb片段（A块）和一个6.0 kb片段（包含OsB2前两个注释外显子）各以三个非串联拷贝存在。该排列通过独立的仅HiFi组装得以重现，并由三条Nanopore读长跨越。在3,000份水稻基因组计划的2,913份材料中，读长深度检测到29份（1.0%）存在A块增加，其中17份为三个或更多拷贝，12份为两个拷贝。全部29份均携带连接A块与OsB2 5'片段的读长对，而58份匹配对照中无一携带。一个第三拷贝特异的连接在17份中的16份和12份中的2份中被发现。在2,055份有种皮颜色记录的材料中，19份紫色材料中有18份携带该增加，两类携带者中分别有13份中的9份和11份中的9份记录为紫色。在210个NCBI组装和264份基因组仓库材料中，5份携带两个A块拷贝的连接，1份中国材料Momi携带三个拷贝，其Nanopore读长予以确认。29份携带者中有21份发现OsKala3启动子重复深度比升高，4份紫色携带者缺乏该特征。结论：ZN65提供了一个无缺口、有读长支持的Kala4/OsB2上游重复序列，该重复在紫米中至少以两种拷贝数形式存在。其基因近端部分与已发表的黑米典型等位基因描述具有相同种类和顺序的元件，尽管片段长度不同。两种形式均在紫色材料中发现，且额外拷贝与记录的颜色无关。其对OsB2表达的影响尚未检测。

papers.title: A sunflower FLS2 guides reconstruction of immune-evasive Xanthomonas flg22 recognition across divergent FLS2 backgrounds
papers.translated_title: 向日葵FLS2指导跨 divergent FLS2 背景重建免疫逃逸型 Xanthomonas flg22 识别
papers.author: Zhong, L.
papers.summary: Immune-evasive Xanthomonas flg22 epitopes pose a challenge to FLS2-mediated immune surveillance. A further challenge is to reconstruct their recognition across divergent FLS2 backgrounds with a limited number of amino-acid substitutions. AlphaFold 3 (AF3) screening of 256 natural FLS2 homologues identified sunflower HaFLS2-1, responsive to flg22Xcc and flg22Xoo in transient ROS assays. We validated flg22Xcc recognition by in planta ligand-association assays and immune responses in stable Arabidopsis lines. Guided by HaFLS2-1 ligand-proximal residues, iterative AF3 searches generated PsFLS2 (Salicaceae) and TjFLS2 (Apocynaceae) variants recognising flg22Xcc with ten or fewer substitutions. Single-residue reversions revealed functional contributions from over half of recurrent substitutions in both backgrounds. RcFLS2 (Rosaceae) variants acquired flg22Xcc responsiveness. In tomato SlFLS2 (Solanaceae), three substitutions significantly enhanced flg22Xcc responses, while all three variants carrying two to four substitutions acquired flg22Xoo responsiveness. These findings demonstrate the utility of AF3-guided natural-receptor discovery and iterative engineering for reconstructing and expanding flg22 recognition.
papers.translated_summary: 免疫逃逸型Xanthomonas flg22表位对FLS2介导的免疫监视构成挑战。另一项挑战是在有限数量的氨基酸替换下，跨不同FLS2背景重建其识别能力。AlphaFold 3（AF3）对256个天然FLS2同源物的筛选鉴定出向日葵HaFLS2-1，其在瞬时ROS实验中响应flg22Xcc和flg22Xoo。我们通过植物体内配体结合实验和稳定拟南芥株系中的免疫反应验证了flg22Xcc的识别。以HaFLS2-1配体近端残基为指导，迭代AF3搜索生成了PsFLS2（Salicaceae）和TjFLS2（Apocynaceae）变体，其以十个或更少替换识别flg22Xcc。单残基回复揭示了两个背景中超过半数重复替换的功能贡献。RcFLS2（Rosaceae）变体获得了flg22Xcc响应性。在番茄SlFLS2（Solanaceae）中，三个替换显著增强了flg22Xcc响应，而所有携带两到四个替换的三个变体均获得了flg22Xoo响应性。这些发现证明了AF3指导的天然受体发现和迭代工程在重建和扩展flg22识别方面的效用。

papers.title: Acetate promotes nutritional adaptation in Escherichia coli
papers.translated_title: 醋酸盐促进大肠杆菌的营养适应
papers.author: Devlin, L.
papers.summary: Escherichia coli often releases acetate in its environment where it can accumulate to concentrations high enough to inhibit the bacterium's own growth. Here, we demonstrate that acetate promotes E. coli adaptation to nutrient changes by accelerating growth resumption, with as little as 250 M acetate being sufficient to shorten the lag phase by several hours. Acetate was found to be consumed via acetyl-CoA synthetase very early after the nutrient change. Transcriptomics, metabolomics and 13C-isotope labeling experiments show that acetate replenishes metabolic pools in the tricarboxylic acid cycle and upper glycolysis. Single-cell analyses reveal that acetate increases the adaptation speed of individual cells switching to the new nutrient. We conclude that the reuse of excreted acetate by E. coli facilitates nutritional adaptation by transiently replenishing central metabolite pools. This work identifies an unexpected role of acetate in the nutritional adaptation of E. coli, providing new insights into the physiological relevance of overflow metabolism.
papers.translated_summary: 大肠杆菌常在其环境中释放乙酸盐，乙酸盐可在环境中积累至足以抑制该细菌自身生长的浓度。在此，我们证明乙酸盐通过加速生长恢复来促进大肠杆菌对营养变化的适应，仅250 M的乙酸盐就足以将延滞期缩短数小时。研究发现，在营养变化后极早期，乙酸盐即通过乙酰辅酶A合成酶被消耗。转录组学、代谢组学和13C同位素标记实验表明，乙酸盐补充了三羧酸循环和上游糖酵解中的代谢池。单细胞分析揭示，乙酸盐提高了单个细胞转向新营养物时的适应速度。我们得出结论：大肠杆菌对排泄的乙酸盐的再利用通过瞬时补充中心代谢物池来促进营养适应。这项工作揭示了乙酸盐在大肠杆菌营养适应中的意外作用，为溢流代谢的生理相关性提供了新见解。
